import pandas as pd

# Source file path
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/test_0.csv"

# Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Inspect columns of source0:
# ['user_id', 'time', 'sore.throat.cough', 'runnynose.congestion.sneezing', 'fever',
#  'nausea.vomiting.diarrhea', 'sad.depressed', 'open.stressed']

# Target schema: ['user_id': integer, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]
# Mapping from source to target:
# user_id -> user_id (int)
# sad.depressed -> sad (float)
# open.stressed -> stressed (float)

# Since source0 has multiple rows per user_id (different times),
# we aggregate by user_id taking the average of sad.depressed and open.stressed.

# Convert columns to numeric (in case of any issues)
df_source0['sad.depressed'] = pd.to_numeric(df_source0['sad.depressed'], errors='coerce')
df_source0['open.stressed'] = pd.to_numeric(df_source0['open.stressed'], errors='coerce')

# Group by user_id and aggregate by mean for sad.depressed and open.stressed
df_agg = df_source0.groupby('user_id', as_index=False).agg({
    'sad.depressed': 'mean',
    'open.stressed': 'mean'
})

# Rename columns to target schema
df_agg.rename(columns={
    'sad.depressed': 'sad',
    'open.stressed': 'stressed'
}, inplace=True)

# Ensure user_id is integer type
df_agg['user_id'] = df_agg['user_id'].astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df_target = df_agg[['user_id', 'sad', 'stressed']]

# Write the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
